snippet.title: Diner Dash 4: Once Upon a Diner - 1001 Bites - Level 1
snippet.description:
Full series playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLnAi-WXs6yIAkoMeWCPI7O6zzdDjJV0Wx


Diner Dash: Once Upon a Diner is the third and last downloadable expansion season for Diner Dash: Hometown Hero, along with Diner Dash: Seasonal Snack Pack and Diner Dash: Flo Through Time respectively. 

Once Upon a Diner is probably the hardest of the Diner Dash Hometown Hero expansion packs. Customers also arrive slower than usual, and certain venues lack a podium.

The story starts in the evening as Flo mops the floor of her diner and Bernie enjoying his storybook and some coffee. Seconds later, Grandma bursts in showing her find at the flea market, a genie lamp! A series of events lands our characters inside Bernie's book, trapped in the story of One Thousand and One Nights. In order to escape, they need to buy the magic mirror, but it's quite expensive. Doing what they do best, Flo and Grandma set up a restaurant to raise funds to buy that mirror.


About the level:
The first thing we'll notice is our regular young ladies are now dancers. They eat, order, and are as patient as the young ladies we regularly serve.

Our first level is pretty simple with waves of customers spaced out evenly so we can easily handle them. We have young ladies, seniors, and hungrymen. Customers will only arrive in red, blue, and/or green. 

While we don't have a podium to keep customers happy longer, we do have a bench. Use it wisely and on customers that could actually benefit from it.

Note: I do not have this game. This video is archive footage.

00:00 Cutscene
